definitions.description: A block of peers allocated to the subscriber: every peer whose bits above the low index_bits are base's. An import names the block by its nonce.
definitions.name: AuthoringPeerBlock

base.description: The block's first peer, in decimal.

accepted_frontier_base64.description: The frontier of the accepted state this delivery leaves its client holding.

exchange_modes.description: How the store accepts an import of this document.

replaces_held.description: Whether the client replaces what it holds with this delivery, because what it named holding is not of this document's history.

schema_version.description: The layout version the document's operations are written in.

update_base64.description: The accepted operations this delivery adds: every one in a snapshot, and in a patch those after the frontier its client held.

definitions.name: MimeValue

value.description: The envelope's `$mime` says how to read the value, and `application/json` admits any JSON.

definitions.title: A value tagged with the media type that says how to read it

metadata.description: Integrations annotate tasks with their own keys.
